hadith:
Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood) - Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir:

On the authority of others, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Punishment exceeds the flogging of the ten stripes, except if one is guilty of a crime necessitating a legal punishment prescribed by Allah."
message:
# A Message of Divine Purity and Accountability

Allah, in His perfect holiness as Al-Quddus, has established clear boundaries and accountability for our actions—reminding us that our words and deeds matter profoundly on the Day of Judgment. Just as Jesus (peace be upon him) emphasized the importance of sincere belief and warned against denying divine signs, we too should strive to live truthfully, fear Allah, and recognize that every action has consequences set by our All-Knowing Lord. Let us purify our intentions, submit to Allah's guidance, and remember that He alone knows what lies within our hearts and the unseen realities beyond our comprehension.
name:
Al Quddus - الْقُدُّوسُ - The Purest

The name Al Quddus emphasizes the purity and sanctity of Allah. It signifies that Allah is free from any imperfection and holds perfect holiness. This name is often invoked in prayers and supplications to highlight the divine essence of purity and to seek closeness to Allah through recognition of His holiness.
verse:
Al-Ma'idah - The Table Spread - 5:111-116

And how I inspired the disciples, “Believe in Me and My messenger!” They declared, “We believe and bear witness that we fully submit ˹to Allah˺.” 

˹Remember˺ when the disciples asked, “O Jesus, son of Mary! Would your Lord be willing to send down to us a table spread with food from heaven?” Jesus answered, “Fear Allah if you are ˹truly˺ believers.”

They said, “We ˹only˺ wish to eat from it to reassure our hearts, to verify you are indeed truthful to us, and to become its witnesses.”

Jesus, son of Mary, prayed, “O Allah, our Lord! Send us from heaven a table spread with food as a feast for us—the first and last of us—and as a sign from You. Provide for us! You are indeed the Best Provider.”

Allah answered, “I am sending it down to you. But whoever among you denies afterwards will be subjected to a torment I have never inflicted on anyone of My creation.”

And ˹on Judgment Day˺ Allah will say, “O Jesus, son of Mary! Did you ever ask the people to worship you and your mother as gods besides Allah?” He will answer, “Glory be to You! How could I ever say what I had no right to say? If I had said such a thing, you would have certainly known it. You know what is ˹hidden˺ within me, but I do not know what is within You. Indeed, You ˹alone˺ are the Knower of all unseen.
